name: select-people
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a ex:Person } ORDER BY ?s

name: select-from-named-graph
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
SELECT ?s WHERE { GRAPH <https://example.org/graph/named> { ?s a ex:Person } } ORDER BY ?s

name: select-typed-literal
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
SELECT ?s ?age WHERE { ?s ex:age ?age } ORDER BY ?age

name: select-language-tagged-literal
sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?l WHERE { ?s rdfs:label ?l } ORDER BY ?l

name: ask-present
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
ASK { ex:alice ex:knows ex:bob }

name: ask-absent
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
ASK { ex:bob ex:knows ex:alice }

name: construct-knows
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
CONSTRUCT { ?a ex:acquaintance ?b } WHERE { ?a ex:knows ?b }

name: select-quoted-triple-annotation
sparql:
PREFIX ex: <https://example.org/>
SELECT ?c WHERE { << ex:alice ex:knows ex:bob >> ex:certainty ?c }
